home.title: Ask a satellite image a question.
home.subtitle: Add one image, or two of the same place, and ask in your own language. You get a plain answer, with the evidence marked on the image.
home.addSecond: Add a second image (optical+SAR pair or before/after)
home.browseHint: or click to choose a GeoTIFF, PNG or JPEG
home.imagesHelp: Required. One image (GeoTIFF, PNG or JPEG), or two for a co-registered optical+SAR pair or before/after comparison — each up to {{size}}.
home.promptPlaceholder: e.g. How many ships are docked in the harbour?
home.promptHint: Write in English or any of the 22 Indian languages. Your question is translated to English for the models, and the answer is translated back.

single.title: One image
single.body: Ask what it shows: count ships in a harbour, find flooded fields, or get a description of the area.

pair.title: Two dates, one place
pair.body: See what changed between them, such as new buildings, flood water or cleared forest, with the changed ground marked.

fusion.title: Optical and radar together
fusion.body: Combine a normal photo with a radar (SAR) image of the same place. Radar sees through cloud, so both together tell you more.
